Both substances irritate the stomach lining, and aspirin also reduces blood clotting, making any bleeding more serious.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX2ShRkxwCdMhjyUUdErg2_4pPa2VHPBJCywpZM4XGk1sGMRAZPbqOKxPBZBfdE2mHymsKeynuPIEKIVXxFhiNiLyhG1Upzk3GW6v_VaG8eFkee7dRsUve8WTa3aHWORthGYmMps7z6g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXjQ82qPWKNM4xJ-DRYEDoD5zYKdsXPTpB8HwzupK5yLwFJCZfHhyLDtMtFsGmTUO6hZ44dF4gJdbgyQaARPY8Tt4RcIIanM6FPnrkCnKKt5FjA_5HhQPnPmEQZ1gQKVnNWYPF)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXogezZPDstPLcj7f8EAJ9L_WL-uxYy8BA-4-SE0OFyu3AvEZVT8FZ_2NP4YO9GezUbFom8R-FGedhat9AixxuSgTWbTt64Y6ojWHbQHNX-8AIYFS0Zj55vkRCQooaNLHvIfIi9g9H4GZ6JVws8adsIPZCYJM00rE)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXIRNK45lKdQZ9OgWwMk8n-ef7mOoIXmHiiZJpivHdyN0JtV4Vk11MtjfqroozSskDNIsnh3Mmd6y0t-UUi_mmgPhHRRzO1raeVcDP7hqiDMXq_X1nNmSdJ08YaihlRDdLVbz82TFE)

### Key Risks

- **Stomach upset and ulcers:** Nausea, heartburn, vomiting, and damage to the stomach lining can occur even with low-dose ("baby") aspirin.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXjQ82qPWKNM4xJ-DRYEDoD5zYKdsXPTpB8HwzupK5yLwFJCZfHhyLDtMtFsGmTUO6hZ44dF4gJdbgyQaARPY8Tt4RcIIanM6FPnrkCnKKt5FjA_5HhQPnPmEQZ1gQKVnNWYPF)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX2ShRkxwCdMhjyUUdErg2_4pPa2VHPBJCywpZM4XGk1sGMRAZPbqOKxPBZBfdE2mHymsKeynuPIEKIVXxFhiNiLyhG1Upzk3GW6v_VaG8eFkee7dRsUve8WTa3aHWORthGYmMps7z6g)
- **Gastrointestinal bleeding:** Heavy or frequent drinking combined with regular aspirin use significantly raises the risk of bleeding in the stomach or intestines.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF157lJ-a8iM8KmjiS0LcPqiXMQnwP-wiDLa7m0V6xQIy8rD-HJhIFPIO7oRML8E4VRTC0DayJejGCaJx4s4ffdpvpA_X-cZcHNjCHlcMSBpySjtdfeqiA0wxbGe3O1FC7Znk5xhPMLiiwXoaTTyxFeo5whkxm_TPf2tU9VIXVZY34ibtgfqNF017vMifPYyQ5k2GH7e1JzIZn6fmFRMMk7d5txDYyFVU9u_GS53-Hi7HY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX2ShRkxwCdMhjyUUdErg2_4pPa2VHPBJCywpZM4XGk1sGMRAZPbqOKxPBZBfdE2mHymsKeynuPIEKIVXxFhiNiLyhG1Upzk3GW6v_VaG8eFkee7dRsUve8WTa3aHWORthGYmMps7z6g)
- **Warning signs of bleeding:** Seek immediate medical care if you notice black or tarry stools, blood in your stool, or vomit that looks like blood or coffee grounds.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXTZUd5VHmh0FEYyIV6PpM_bzdnsvRcQORbGNgq9DCpZnEmwaMxmKBgK3Q3he2iWO_Wz3WazYefHtsTBM12DNsQ8KNpcfJQdXg7g3zE43iK4R9IIPJmXFZQyzncLXy2ltfIWohztGSDCNgGg)

#### Practical Precautions

- **Limit alcohol:** If a doctor approves alcohol while you take aspirin, keep intake low—generally no more than 1 drink per day for women and men over 65, and up to 2 drinks per day for men under 65. Avoid heavy or binge drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX2ShRkxwCdMhjyUUdErg2_4pPa2VHPBJCywpZM4XGk1sGMRAZPbqOKxPBZBfdE2mHymsKeynuPIEKIVXxFhiNiLyhG1Upzk3GW6v_VaG8eFkee7dRsUve8WTa3aHWORthGYmMps7z6g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXogezZPDstPLcj7f8EAJ9L_WL-uxYy8BA-4-SE0OFyu3AvEZVT8FZ_2NP4YO9GezUbFom8R-FGedhat9AixxuSgTWbTt64Y6ojWHbQHNX-8AIYFS0Zj55vkRCQooaNLHvIfIi9g9H4GZ6JVws8adsIPZCYJM00rE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXclzldzQDZqAe3_NQzRZ8B6VjZjHVZEhMGoVQmBDb5jI0VZK8QfPWfhXcHjaRMsthGt9ZlIUC1Kmsn8neQ5ltAoAKozaC8ur63NSpDSPXb2zSRKtCGtpSDOmqE9iomkoEmG7eP2oKx5jcNSklsw)
- **Space them out:** Avoid taking aspirin immediately before, during, or right after drinking. For more details on timing and side effects, see [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX2ShRkxwCdMhjyUUdErg2_4pPa2VHPBJCywpZM4XGk1sGMRAZPbqOKxPBZBfdE2mHymsKeynuPIEKIVXxFhiNiLyhG1Upzk3GW6v_VaG8eFkee7dRsUve8WTa3aHWORthGYmMps7z6g).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXjQ82qPWKNM4xJ-DRYEDoD5zYKdsXPTpB8HwzupK5yLwFJCZfHhyLDtMtFsGmTUO6hZ44dF4gJdbgyQaARPY8Tt4RcIIanM6FPnrkCnKKt5FjA_5HhQPnPmEQZ1gQKVnNWYPF)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXogezZPDstPLcj7f8EAJ9L_WL-uxYy8BA-4-SE0OFyu3AvEZVT8FZ_2NP4YO9GezUbFom8R-FGedhat9AixxuSgTWbTt64Y6ojWHbQHNX-8AIYFS0Zj55vkRCQooaNLHvIfIi9g9H4GZ6JVws8adsIPZCYJM00rE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX2ShRkxwCdMhjyUUdErg2_4pPa2VHPBJCywpZM4XGk1sGMRAZPbqOKxPBZBfdE2mHymsKeynuPIEKIVXxFhiNiLyhG1Upzk3GW6v_VaG8eFkee7dRsUve8WTa3aHWORthGYmMps7z6g)
- **Check with a clinician:** Ask a doctor or pharmacist before combining them if you take daily low-dose aspirin, use blood thinners or other NSAIDs, or have a history of ulcers or liver issues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXXyS9cMdDcTGDEl0jz_5h9n61n2qxVA8dcRpDpRNXvdJbwiNsBN8LvRy6LiIwU76F7k9fa1b2z2azHm6nPd0MK-LraQlBeZGOE9TdLMsVkBDnhJcSFjfhevNTXRdM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXjQ82qPWKNM4xJ-DRYEDoD5zYKdsXPTpB8HwzupK5yLwFJCZfHhyLDtMtFsGmTUO6hZ44dF4gJdbgyQaARPY8Tt4RcIIanM6FPnrkCnKKt5FjA_5HhQPnPmEQZ1gQKVnNWYPF)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXRjs0k1G9y2Y-y7uMC3mf5tbMhloW9KqJMHzsGCA3NHzEi6yrMHUqxRptTMWL-rvvVIOwc5kSERTjCDrcPResCbAM1OURpwmYd0DhXEdHRe1alzb9dSSTkffG6TI1OBLgS6tNEV6sKg)
